parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: NextHop
parameters.description: The next hop of the policy-based route.

parameters.name: OverlayMode
parameters.description: The tunneling protocol. Set the value to **Ipsec** (IPsec tunneling protocol).

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description:
The policy priority of the policy-based route.

- If no policy priority was previously configured for the policy-based route, you do not need to specify this parameter.
- If a policy priority was previously configured for the policy-based route, you can choose whether to specify this parameter.

    If you specify this parameter, enter the policy priority that was previously configured for the policy-based route. If you enter a different value, the operation fails.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the VPN gateway instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: RouteDest
parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of the policy-based route.

parameters.name: RouteSource
parameters.description: The source CIDR block of the policy-based route.

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPN gateway.

parameters.name: Weight
parameters.description:
The weight of the policy-based route.

You can call the [DescribeVpnPbrRouteEntries](~~2526959~~) operation to query the weight of the policy-based route.
